title: UpdateAllOutcome
description:
Result of `update_all`: one [`UpdateAllItem`] per requested skill, in the
order each one finished (not the order requested), plus the message for
any that failed.

items.description: One entry per skill `update_all` was asked to refresh.

errors.description: `skill.0` -> error message, for every item whose `outcome` is `None`.

UpdateAllItem.description: One skill's result inside an `update_all` batch.

skill.description: The skill this result is for.

outcome.description:
`Some` on success, `None` when this skill's update failed - the
failure's message is the matching entry in
[`UpdateAllOutcome::errors`].

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

tree_hash_before.description: The tree's git tree SHA before this update.

tree_hash_after.description: The tree's git tree SHA after this update.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.
